title: kbpublic.texts drops a path with a newline before git is asked, so a _root.md in such a directory is neither refused nor read as not public by tree_refusals and internal_prefixes
goal: texts_marked answers a spec that texts skipped for a newline as unreadable, so tree_refusals refuses and internal_prefixes lists the root as it does for an invalid-UTF-8 _root.md

run:
import subprocess,sys,tempfile
sys.path.insert(0,"_tools")
import kbpublic
d=tempfile.mkdtemp()
def g(*a,i=None): return subprocess.run(["git","-c","user.name=t","-c","user.email=t@example.com",*a],cwd=d,check=True,capture_output=True,input=i).stdout.decode().strip()
g("init","-q")
b=g("hash-object","-w","--stdin",i=b"visibility: internal\n")
g("update-index","--add","--cacheinfo","100644,"+b+",kb/a\nb/_root.md")
g("commit","-qm","x")
files=kbpublic.tree_files("HEAD",d)
r=kbpublic.internal_prefixes("HEAD",files,d)
sys.exit(0 if any(chr(10) in p for p in r) else 1)

repro_reason: needs a git tree with a path holding a newline; the planted input is in the notes
notes: SP-mut2pmu3 review gap 3 (S3). kbpublic.py texts() skips specs holding a newline (:437-466) and texts_marked marks only invalid UTF-8; used by blobs_marked in tree_refusals (:540) and internal_prefixes (:687). Planted: kb/public/_root.md public plus kb/<name with a newline>/_root.md saying visibility: internal; tree_refusals gives no cause for it. history_refusals catches it only for the commit that wrote it, by blob sha. Fix: answer a skipped spec as None in texts_marked.
